verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online IP-filing service, so headless or programmatic automation (for example an API or CLI for submissions) is a fair question. However, the evidence only describes patent, trademark and design procedures carried out by human applicants, plus a guide for online filing. Nothing shows an API, CLI, headless mode or CI integration, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
